Subject: Azure + ScoutCloud co-sell demo — proposed time & contingency

Hi Nadia —

Thanks again for agreeing to the joint demo with Azure next week. We want to lock a time that works for your execs and also keep an ops rehearsal window in reserve in case we need to swap hosts. Proposed options (all times PDT):

- Option A: Tue May 11, 10:00–11:00 (good for EMEA morning, APAC late afternoon)
- Option B: Wed May 12, 14:00–15:00 (EMEA afternoon, APAC evening)

If neither works, can you share two 1-hr blocks that work for the ScoutCloud execs? We’ll hold both on our side but ask Vanessa to keep the rehearsal host on standby (attached is a short rehearsal host list).

Notes:
- Agenda attached (scout-demo-agenda-v2.pdf) — will run 25m product walkthrough, 20m joint architecture Q&A, 10m next steps.
- We’re expecting the Azure Partner Manager (cc’d) to join for the architecture portion.
- If an exec conflict comes up, we can do a 30-min condensed exec-only slot plus a separate technical deep-dive.

Would you prefer we propose calendar invites, or would you like ScoutCloud to send a preferred slot?

Thanks — looking forward to locking this down.

Best,
Ben Carter
Sr. Partner Rep, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0134

Attachments: scout-demo-agenda-v2.pdf, rehearsal-host-list.xlsx

Date: 2026-05-03T14:08:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Azure + ScoutCloud co-sell demo — proposed time & contingency

Hi Ben —

Thanks for the options. Unfortunately our VP of Product has a travel surge that week and just pushed a calendar change through this morning. Can we move the joint demo to the week of May 17?

Prefer these windows for execs (CEST):
- Tue May 18, 09:30–10:30 CEST
- Thu May 20, 14:00–15:00 CEST

If those are a hard no for Azure, we can do Wed May 19 afternoon CEST but it would need to be a 30-min exec run then schedule a separate 60-min tech deep-dive the following week.

Also — can you confirm the rehearsal host will be available for a full run-through 24–48 hours before the customer demo? We had a missed handoff on a previous joint and want to avoid that.

Best,
Nadia
Head of Partnerships, ScoutCloud
nadia.raz@scoutcloud.com

Vanessa / Karthik —

Heads up — ScoutCloud needs to push to the week of May 17. They prefer Tue 5/18 09:30 CEST or Thu 5/20 14:00 CEST. That converts to our times as:
- Tue 5/18 00:30–01:30 PDT (not great for hosts)
- Thu 5/20 05:00–06:00 PDT (early, but manageable)

Action items: can Vanessa hold the Azure co-sell calendar for Thu 5/20 05:00 PDT as our primary (and set a rehearsal 48h prior on Tue 5/18 05:00 PDT)? If the early time is a blocker for the Azure Partner, we’ll propose Wed 5/19 17:00 CEST (which is Wed 5/19 08:00 PDT) as the compromise.

I’ll update the HubSpot deal (SCOUT-2026-0892) and send a short note to the Azure partner asking for confirmation on their availability.

Thanks — Ben

P.S. Vanessa — please use the rehearsal-host-list.xlsx to pick the host and set the rollout notes (who will control screen share, who will handle Q&A).

Hi Nadia —

Thanks for the quick reply. We can do Thu May 20, 14:00–15:00 CEST (Thu May 20, 05:00–06:00 PDT) — I’ve tentatively held that slot on our side and created the calendar invite below.

Google Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=azure-scout-demo
HubSpot: https://hubspot.com/deals/SCOUT-2026-0892

Rehearsal: Tue May 18, 05:00–05:45 PDT (will be 14:00 CEST for your team) — Vanessa will run the 45-min run-through; rehearsal-host-list.xlsx attached for visibility.

Next steps:
- Nadia: confirm the exec list (names + emails) so we can set the true calendar invite recipients.
- Azure Partner (cc): please confirm you can join the 05:00 PDT / 14:00 CEST demo window or flag a veto — we’ll pivot to the Wed compromise if needed.
- Vanessa: please add the rehearsal invite and include a short doc in the Drive folder that lists handoff responsibilities.

If all good I’ll finalize invites and the one-page follow-up doc.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
